name: 46151 · Martinsville, IN
findings: ZIP 46151 (Martinsville) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46151 (Martinsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46151 (Martinsville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
